label: Flag
depicts: Rectangular flag panel with a forked notch on a vertical line pole
use_when: Use when the interface wants a simple pole flag with a rectangular body and a forked tail notch.
avoid_when: Do not use for the triangular or wavy flags when the body should stay rectangular.

label: Flag
depicts: Angled flag panel on a vertical line pole with a diagonal lower edge
use_when: Use when the interface wants a stiffer banner shape with straight edges and a diagonal bottom.
avoid_when: Do not use for the notch or pennant flags when the body is a four sided angled panel.

label: Flag
depicts: Triangular flag panel with a vertical line pole at the left
use_when: Use when the interface wants a simple triangular pennant instead of a rectangular flag body.
avoid_when: Do not use for wider flags when the pointed triangle shape is the main cue.

label: Flag
depicts: Wavy flag outline with a vertical line pole at the left
use_when: Use when the interface wants a soft cloth like flag shape rather than a stiff banner panel.
avoid_when: Do not use for the straight edged flags when the wavy cloth outline should remain visible.

label: Building
depicts: Tall slanted center tower with short side panels on both sides above a base
use_when: Use when the interface wants a modern three tower building with a tall central wedge.
avoid_when: Do not use for the flatter buildings when the central slanted tower and two side towers matter.
